summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (MariaDB 10.11 + galera 26.4) across node1/node2/node3 on RHEL 10, seeded application data (appdb.orders), performed a full cluster maintenance-window shutdown and clean restart with all committed writes preserved and all three members serving again, then performed the mandatory sequential OS-level restart of each node (one at a time, preserving quorum) with proven boot-identity changes and post-restart cluster/data verification for every node.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, mariadb-backup on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_on=1, cluster_address listing all 3 IPs, per-node wsrep_node_name/address, rsync SST
Opened firewalld ports 3306, 4567(tcp/udp), 4568, 4444 on all nodes and reloaded
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 (galera_new_cluster), then joined node2 and node3 via systemctl start mariadb; confirmed cluster_size=3, Synced, Primary
Enabled mariadb service on boot on all 3 nodes
Created appdb.orders table and inserted 3 committed rows on node1; verified replication to node2/node3
Captured healthy baseline (cluster status, size, data, boot_id) on all nodes before maintenance
Performed full cluster shutdown: stopped node2, then node3, then node1 last (retaining safe_to_bootstrap=1, highest seqno=8)
Confirmed all 3 nodes fully down (maintenance window in effect)
Restarted cluster: bootstrapped node1 (galera_new_cluster), verified data intact, then started node2 and node3 which rejoined via SST and reached Synced/cluster_size=3
Verified all committed writes present on all 3 nodes; performed a live multi-master write test on node2 that replicated to node1/node3
Sequentially OS-rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time, preserving 2-of-3 quorum during each), using systemctl reboot backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node until exec was available again and confirmed boot_id changed for each node
After each node's reboot, confirmed mariadb auto-started, rejoined the cluster (cluster_size=3, Synced), and appdb.orders data was intact before moving to the next node
Final full-cluster health check across all 3 nodes: Primary/Synced, cluster_size=3, 4 consistent rows in appdb.orders

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-node Galera cluster established with application data before maintenance
evidence.summary: Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3; all reached cluster_size=3/Synced/Primary; appdb.orders (3 rows) created on node1 and confirmed replicated identically to node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: Stopped node2, node3, then node1 (last, preserving safe_to_bootstrap=1 and highest seqno=8); confirmed mariadb inactive on all three nodes simultaneously

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up after maintenance with all committed writes present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped from its highest-seqno state with all 3 original rows intact; node2 and node3 rejoined via SST reaching Synced/cluster_size=3; a new write on node2 replicated correctly to node1 and node3, proving all 3 members are serving read/write traffic

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 254597f8...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id eb1d468c... (changed); mariadb auto-rejoined reaching cluster_size=3/Synced with appdb.orders data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 636556ce...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 798d0da1... (changed); mariadb auto-rejoined reaching cluster_size=3/Synced with data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7ef78016...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id bd2e6f04... (changed); mariadb auto-rejoined reaching cluster_size=3/Synced with appdb.orders data intact in the same command

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health and data consistency after all restarts
evidence.summary: All 3 nodes report cluster_size=3, Synced/Primary, and identical row count (4) in appdb.orders, confirming quorum and data consistency after the full restart sequence
